You were having trouble sleeping lately—a combined effort of overworking yourself, classes in college, and spending nights awake over and over again to watch TV or play video games. You were *exhausted*, your body barely even there. Drained, spent, and sluggish. A modern day zombie, it felt like.

So, as any normal person does when faced with an insurmountable stressor in their lives…

You made it worse. An energy drink and one of those galaxy brownies with the colored sprinkles, and you’re out like a fucking light. 

—

You wake up with your face—quite literally, almost—glued to your desk. It’s pitch black in your room, the only light a faint deep blue as it bleeds through your shoddy curtains in the center of your apartment bedroom. 

You groggily manage to pull yourself off the desk, before spotting two, distinct, ethereal green dots glowing just across the room. At first you think they’re the LEDs of one of you consoles—that thought is squashed as soon as you really adjust to the dark.

“Good morning, sleepyhead.” A voice drawls; something slow with a timbre you can’t quite place. “Rest well?”
